newsitem.title: USA: Vishay Intertechnology to consolidate unit.
newsitem.headline: Vishay Intertechnology to consolidate unit.

text.p: Vishay Intertechnology Inc has decided to consolidate its Vishay Electronic Components operations, Vishay Chairman and Chief Executive Felix Zandman said on Wednesday.
Those operations in the United States, Europe, Israel and Asia are to be combined into one entity, prompting a host of executive appointments, he said.
The move comes about a month after Vishay made a failed attempt to acquire Kemet Corp, an independent electronics components manufacturer based in Greenville, S.C.
Gerald Paul, formerly president of Vishay Electronics Components-Europe, has been named chief operating officer of Vishay Intertechnology Inc.
Donald Alfson, formerly president of the electronics unit in the United States and Asia, has been named chief business development officer of Vishay Intertechnology.
Paul and Alfson also have been appointed executive vice presidents of the company and will serve on the executive committee of the board of directors.
